display.purpose: The home intro sentence and page titles.

row-title.purpose: Product names and post titles in ledgers.

motion.name: develop
motion.purpose: Portrait settles from blur and low exposure on load; disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: link
motion.purpose: Underline colour and text colour on hover.

components.name: koative mark
components.description: Two dots, blue then coral, in front of the word koative. The only colour on the site.
components.css: .ds-koative { font-family: 'Clash Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 2rem; color: #f2f1ee; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-dots { display: inline-flex; gap: 0.07em; margin-inline-end: 0.16em; vertical-align: 0.1em; } .ds-dots i { width: 0.4em; height: 0.4em; border-radius: 50%; background: #2f3bff; } .ds-dots i + i { background: #ff5b45; }

components.name: Status badge
components.description: Product status from products.json: Live (filled dot), Beta (ring), Coming soon (no dot).
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.45em; padding: 0.2em 0.75em; border: 1px solid #26262b; border-radius: 999px; color: #a9a9b0; font: 400 0.875rem Switzer, sans-serif; } .ds-status::before { content: ''; width: 0.45em; height: 0.45em; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid currentColor; } .ds-live::before { background: #f2f1ee; border-color: #f2f1ee; }

components.name: Ledger row
components.description: One product, log entry or post: hairlines above and below, whole row clickable.
components.html: OpenMacAppsAn app-store-style catalogue of open-source Mac apps.
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 1.5rem 0.75rem; border-block: 1px solid #26262b; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.3s; } .ds-row:hover { background: #141417; } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f2f1ee; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-row-title { font: 500 1.875rem/1.1 'Clash Grotesk', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #f2f1ee; } .ds-row-text { font: 400 1rem Switzer, sans-serif; color: #a9a9b0; }

components.name: Quiet link
components.description: Nav and meta links: read as text until hovered, then underline in light.
components.css: .ds-link { color: #a9a9b0; font: 400 1rem Switzer, sans-serif; text-decoration: underline 1px transparent; text-underline-offset: 0.22em; transition: text-decoration-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-link:hover { color: #f2f1ee; text-decoration-color: #f2f1ee; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f2f1ee; outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview: One B&W portrait and one plain sentence, then ledgers of real things. Light on the koative void, in greys; the koative dots are the only colour.

rules.name: Two dots only
rules.body: Blue and coral appear only as the dots in front of the word koative.

rules.name: Names in Clash
rules.body: Anything that is a name or heading is Clash Grotesk; reading text is Switzer.

dos: Do let real products and dates carry the page.
donts: Don't add a light theme, gradient or second accent.
Don't put an eyebrow above a heading.
